## DASHBOARD IS LIVE
Your hosted dashboard is connected to the Creek Freak Sleeper league. Live roster, matchup, standings, transactions and waiver-trend data refresh directly from Sleeper.

## MONDAY REPORT
Starting Monday, this section will contain the full weekly analysis: NFL recap, league-specific waiver priorities, suggested drops, trades to pursue, buy-low/sell-high opportunities, and players to watch.

## NO API KEY REQUIRED
You do not need an OpenAI API key on your computer. The weekly report will be prepared in ChatGPT and published here.
